steps.js: const els=[...document.querySelectorAll('label, span, div')].filter(e=>/^\s*用卡/.test(e.innerText||'') && e.querySelector('select')); const e=els.sort((a,b)=>a.innerText.length-b.innerText.length)[0]; if(!e) return 'none'; const sel=e.querySelector('select'); const w=document.createTreeWalker(e,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); let tn; while((tn=w.nextNode())){ if(tn.textContent.includes('用卡')) break; } const r=document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(tn); const tr=r.getBoundingClientRect(); const s=sel.getBoundingClientRect(); const hint=e.querySelector('.v3e-lanehint')||e.parentElement.querySelector('.v3e-lanehint'); const h=hint?.getBoundingClientRect(); return {labelMid:+(tr.top+tr.height/2).toFixed(1), selectMid:+(s.top+s.height/2).toFixed(1), selectH:Math.round(s.height), labelLeft:Math.round(tr.left), hintLeft:h?Math.round(h.left):null, hintText:hint?.innerText.slice(0,30)};
